newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: World air cargo traffic up 5.3pct in Jan-Aug - ACI.
newsitem.headline: World air cargo traffic up 5.3pct in Jan-Aug - ACI.

text.p: Freight and mail traffic handled by 483 airports around the world between January and August 1996, totalled 32.1 million tonnes, up 5.3 percent on the same period the previous year, said Geneva-based Airports Council International (ACI).
North America, the biggest of ACI's six cargo-handling regions, reported 16.78 million tonnes of freight traffic, up 6.2 percent on January-August 1995.
Cargo traffic handled during the first eight months of the year at ACI's Europe member airports totalled 6.54 million tonnes, a rise of 4.0 percent on the same period in 1995.

Airports in the Asia/Pacific region (in which ACI incorporates Indo-China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Thailand, Japan, Malaysia and Australia), handled 6.49 million tonnes, an increase of 4.4 percent on the first eight months of last year, ACI said.
Middle East airports recorded the highest growth rate of ACI's cargo-handling regions, rising 13.8 percent to 1.24 million tonnes.
Latin America/Caribbrean airports, January-August 1996 freight traffic was down 4.0 percent on 1995 levels at 727,747 tonnes.
African airports cargo traffic declined by 1.4 percent on the first eight months of 1995 to 290,000 tonnes. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
